desc.color.transparent: Fully transparent. Used for ghost/tertiary backgrounds.
desc.font.family.sans: Primary UI family. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next was designed by the Braille Institute for low-vision readers: distinct letterforms (Il1, 0O) reduce misreads of names, times and IDs.
desc.stroke-style.dashed: Reserved for tentative/pending holds so pending is distinguishable without color.
desc.stroke.focus: Focus ring thickness (≥2px CSS px for WCAG 2.4.13-style visibility).
desc.stroke.indicator: Active tab underline, calendar event status bar.
desc.focus-ring.$root: Focus indicator for every interactive element. Applied as an outline with an offset.
desc.motion.control: Hover/press/selection feedback. Reduced-motion users get duration 0 (see CSS).
desc.opacity.disabled-media: Images/avatars inside disabled rows. Never used for text.
desc.color.text.muted: Placeholders, timestamps. Still meets 4.5:1 on default and subtle surfaces.
desc.color.text.disabled: Disabled text. Exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 but always paired with a disabled container.
desc.color.surface.elevated: Menus, modals, sheets. In dark mode elevation is expressed by lightness.
desc.color.surface.subtle: Table headers, search fields, off-hours calendar cells.
desc.color.border.default: Card and container edges. Decorative; containers are also separated by surface color.
desc.color.border.strong: Boundaries of interactive controls (inputs, checkboxes, chips). Meets 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).
desc.color.border.focus: Focus ring color. Meets 3:1 against all surfaces.
desc.color.interaction.hover: Hover fill for rows, list items, ghost controls.
desc.color.interaction.focus.offset: Gap between control and ring so the ring reads on any fill.
desc.size.touch-target: Minimum hit area. Mobile 48 exceeds WCAG 2.5.8 (24) and matches platform HIG guidance; desktop uses the 24px AA minimum for pointer input.
desc.size.selection-control: Checkbox/radio visual size (hit area is touch-target).
desc.size.nav-bar: Mobile bottom nav height / desktop top bar height.
desc.radius.modal: Mobile modals render as bottom sheets (top corners only).
desc.text-style.input: Mobile inputs stay at 16px so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus.
